name: Cold Outreach Email
description: Writes a personalized cold outreach email to a hiring manager or professional contact, optimized for response rate. Produces a complete email with subject line, body, and call to action that is concise, specific, and avoids generic templates. Use when the user wants to email a hiring manager directly, reach out to a professional contact about opportunities, or write a cold email for job search purposes. Do NOT use for recruiter messages (use recruiter-outreach), networking messages for informational interviews (use networking-message-writer), or post-interview thank-you emails (use thank-you-email-writer).
